{{recipe}}

This '''spicy garlic oil''' is nice for frying chicken, fish, and fries.

== Ingredients ==
* ½ gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as [[Cookbook:Rapeseed Oil|canola]], [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]], [[Cookbook:Safflower Oil|safflower]], [[Cookbook:Grape Seed Oil|grapeseed]], or soybean
* 40 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 8 Thai bird [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]], stemmed and halved
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot.
#Heat over low heat for 1 hour.
#[[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]], cool, and store in the refrigerator until oil smells off, looks smoky, or tastes rancid.
